tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Anahana's wellness content — angel numbers, astrology, zodiac, tarot, crystals, yoga, meditation, breathing exercises, mental and physical health, and more — in any of 24 languages. Returns matching articles with title, url, section, language, and a short summary. Matching is KEYWORD/SUBSTRIN

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch a specific Anahana article as markdown, given its full URL, site-relative path (e.g. "/en/angel-numbers/111-angel-number/"), or a bare slug from search_content results (e.g. "111-angel-number"). Tries two fetch modes against the live site in order: (1) content negotiation — GET the article URL

tools.name: lookup_angel_number
tools.description: Resolve a specific angel number (e.g. "111", "1234", "22") to its Anahana article URL, in any of 24 languages. Slugs are English-stable across every language — most numbers are "<number>-angel-number"; the single digits 1-9, the master numbers 11/22/.../99, and the outlier 828 use "angel-number-<num

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_article" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_content, get_article · Private data: search_content · Public sink: lookup_angel_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_content, get_article · Private data: search_content · Public sink: lookup_angel_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
